description: Get AI-powered mortgage rate decision from 4,300+ US lenders. Returns recommended actions, current APR rates, estimated monthly payments, and confidence scores. Supports 30yr/15yr fixed and ARM products. Filter by state, amount, and credit tier.

amount.description: Loan amount in USD (e.g. 400000 for a $400K mortgage)

credit_score.description: Credit score tier for rate filtering

term_months.description: Loan term in months: 180 (15yr), 360 (30yr), or custom

name: rateapi.lending.mortgage

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: US Mortgage Rate Decision
